[[File:ViqiShesh-NEGTC.png|thumb|right|220px|Viqi Shesh of Kuat.]]
{{Quote|She's from Kuat. Nobody expects her to have any character.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on Kuati stereoptypes|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Recovery">''[[The New Jedi Order: Recovery]]''</ref>}}
A '''Kuati''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Their society was in some aspects matriarchal and dominated by powerful ruling families that constantly fought among themselves and employed [[telbun]]s to prevent inbreeding. Kuati [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] referred to themselves in the [[Wikipedia:Pluralis majestatis|royal we]].

Kuati were widely known across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for their shipbuilding skills and their control of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. These [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] would build [[Warship/Legends|warships]] for a variety of governments including the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
The origin of the Kuati was traced thousands of years ago when a group of [[The Ten|ten wealthy]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] families banded together with the purpose of forming the biggest and most influential shipbuilding concern in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Initial obstacles were faced at the hands of the fledgling trading consortiums that were ancient predecessors of the greedy [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. These consortiums attempted to stop the merchant families from realizing their goal. This saw acts of [[Spy/Legends|espionage]], [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]], and supposed [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attacks being made against them with the source of these occurrences not being able to be traced. Ultimately, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] aristocratic families settled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] in [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] where the Kuati merchants hired the finest [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformers]], ecologists and animal breeders to turn the barren world into a paradise. At the same time, engineers worked to create half a dozen shipyards to form the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

[[File:Kuat_aristocrat.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A female Kuati aristocrat]]
In the years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], the leading merchant family amongst the Kuati was the [[House Kuat|Kuat family]] that had a long storied history of being one of the [[Core Founder/Legends|Core Founders]]. This saw Kuat hold an important role and voice in the Galactic Republic as it was responsible for constructing the vast [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of ships. These starships were seen in many battles such as the [[Old Sith Wars]] and the [[New Sith Wars]]. During the reign of [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Risi Lenoan]] acted as the Kuati representative and was handpicked delegate by [[Onara Kuat]] to ensure that the person benefited the Kuat Drive Yards and ultimately the Kuat family by extension.<ref name="db">{{DB|character|onarakuat|Kuat, Onara}}</ref> By the time of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Senator Risi Lenoan represented Kuat and was present during the unveiling of a new starfighter for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Senator Lenoan was present alongside [[Project Engineer]] Lead [[Walex Blissex/Legends|Walex Blissex]] where they presented the [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor]] to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] officials [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]].<ref name="HNNV53147">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|jediwatch/13314_1.html|New Jedi Starfighter Unveiled}}</ref>

Senator Lenoan served faithfully until she was removed from office when questions came regarding her book keeping and KDY funds. As a result, Onara Kuat made [[Giddean Danu/Legends|Giddean Danu]] as the new Kuati Senator and believed him to be a malleable political figurehead. However, his views opposed that of the Kuat family as he did not favor the centralization of power within the Republic and supported Jedi oversight during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Kuat of Kuat/Legends|Kuat of Kuat]] believed Senator Danu to be an effective advocate of Kuati independence and any motion to remove him failed. Giddean Danu even declared his intention to reform Kuati politics and investigating Onara Kuat's family.<ref name="db" /> During the Clone Wars, the Republic stationed increased defensive forces at Kuat due to fears over conflict with nearby [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]]. This saw the Kuati attempt to infiltrate Neimoidia with modified worker droids equipped with concealed spyware. However, fifteen of these spy-droids were captured in a highly publicized event that was claimed as a victory in stopping the Kuati from stealing [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] secrets.<ref name="CISSD.14701">{{InsiderCite|68|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:7:01 Edition}}</ref>

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was established and the Kuati aristocracy generally remained loyal to the new government due to their strong heritage in supporting the Republic along with its successors. Governance of the Kuat system falling into the hands of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Thichis Kuras]] who was a Kuati though one from the lesser nobility. His appointment was made by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in order to balance Kuat's military security needs with Kuati's aristocratic sense of self-governance along with its regal pride. However, Senator Giddean Danu who was a representative to the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] secretly supported the efforts of [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] as well as [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] to undermine the Empire's authority. In this time, the Kuati's sought to ensure their continued economic success through vast commercial starship construction operations.<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> As a result, the great Kuati merchant houses became astonishingly wealthy and notoriously insular during the years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. This was due to Emperor Palpatine's reign bringing about the largest military buildup in galactic history.<ref name="TEGPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>

==Society==
Kuati houses were often composed of a single extended aristocratic family. Each house had long ago devised a system to prevent unfortunate political alliances that sometimes were brought about as a result of ill-advised marriage.<ref name="TEGPM" />

Amongst outsiders, it was believed Kuati politics were labyrinthine and cutthroat. Traits such as nepotism, graft, corruption and cronyism were abound with the lines between an aristocrat, business executive and politician being blurred amongst their people.<ref name="db" />

An ancient nautical tradition amongst the Kuati involved using a gilded blade to cut a symbolic tether attached to a prototype ship.<ref name="HNNV53147" />
